title: Checkpoint
description: Immutable snapshot of an execution run's state. A checkpoint can be used to resume the same run or as the starting point for a forked run.

checkpoint_id.description: Stable identifier for this checkpoint. It identifies the snapshot, not an execution run.

parent_run_id.description: Identifier of the execution run that produced this checkpoint.

state_digest.description: Content digest of the complete checkpointed state. Consumers use it to verify resume or fork input.

timestamp.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the checkpoint was captured.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative producer context for the checkpoint, such as runtime or storage details.
